machine: Boat large sandbox, AMD Ryzen 9 9950X, 8 vCPUs; server on CPUs 0-3, oha 1.16.0 on CPUs 4-7
method: 64 keep-alive connections, two oha workers, 3 s discarded warmup, 10 s sample, three samples per variant, rounds alternate forward and reverse order
note: This branch, all variants; the host slowed during the run (one process measured 9,900-14,200 hello req/s), kept for completeness
